strongest_contra_findings: Most opportunities still lack customer validation.
Hardware/consumer paths may require capabilities and distribution Y* does not yet have.
Agent-economy paths may be early relative to buyer budget.
strongest_pro_findings: AI productivity and enterprise/professional clusters have the clearest near-term buyer language.
Agent-economy/autonomous-company clusters have high strategic upside if authority/evidence problems become urgent.
Human-life and hardware clusters expand imagination beyond governance, but need prototype-first evidence.
